theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_canon_tangent_plane_hasDensity
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ)
